protocol.question: Separate migration-induced long-horizon drift from native backbone instability, and test whether a one-step older carried W2 anchor rescues native-stable migration failures.
protocol.native_stable_rule: W3-native task invariant must remain true at 128, 512, and 2048 for a fixture/future case to enter the migration-only denominator.
protocol.migration_excess_rule: On a native-stable case, selected migrated state must keep task invariants and functional decision agreement=1.0 at every horizon.
protocol.native_coverage_gate: At least 6/8 cases native-stable and at least one native-stable stream per fixture.
protocol.anchor_ablation: Evaluation-only comparison of chain-v2 selected W2-origin anchor against the immediately older available W2-origin anchor. W3-native is evaluation-only and is not used to select either anchor.
protocol.oracle_usage: none for selector or ablation anchor choice

interpretation_rule.selector_pruning_problem: migration-only excess failures are rescued by the older W2 anchor
interpretation_rule.backbone_problem: native_coverage_gate=false or native instability is widespread
interpretation_rule.clean_pass: all immediate chain fixtures qualify, native coverage gate passes, and migration-only excess failure count is zero

claim_boundary: Synthetic target-free selector-v3 diagnostic on the same RWKV-7 0.4B G7 cause-isolation suite. The policy uses no future/native oracle for anchor choice. Passing the migration-only denominator would show that conservative bounded replay can fix the observed migration drift; it would not resolve native 0.4B instability or justify final selector/backbone freeze.

selector_v3_policy.name: earliest-carried-W2 functional-equivalence guard
selector_v3_policy.basis: G7 anchor-depth v3 showed all four native-stable migration failures are rescuable by a carried W2-origin anchor
selector_v3_policy.oracle_usage: none for selection; W3-native remains evaluation-only in the inherited G7 protocol
selector_v3_policy.intent: test whether conservative replay depth eliminates migration-only excess failures without changing the backbone or adaptation recipe
selector_v3_policy.freeze_status: diagnostic only; do not freeze this policy even if it passes
